newsitem.title: FRANCE: French CDR's H1 loss seen at 4.5 bln Ffr - paper.
newsitem.headline: French CDR's H1 loss seen at 4.5 bln Ffr - paper.

text.p: The Consortium de Realisation (CDR), an agency created to absorb the doubtful assets of ailing state-owned bank Credit Lyonnais, lost around 4.5 billion francs in the first half of 1996, the newspaper La Tribune reported on Wednesday.
It said a comparison with CDR's first-half 1995 results was not possible as they were never made public.
The CDR lost 21.4 billion francs for all of 1995, including 8.2 billion francs of capital losses on asset sales.

La Tribune said the CDR's full-year loss was expected to be more than double the 1996 first-half loss because of the sale of MGM studios, expected to result in a capital loss of several billion francs.
It said the CDR was expected this year to step up asset sales to around 40 billion francs from 27 billion in 1995.
